title: item.get
description: Retrieve items according to the given parameters.

itemids.description: Return only items with the given IDs.

groupids.description: Return only items that belong to the hosts from the given groups.

templateids.description: Return only items that belong to the given templates.

hostids.description: Return only items that belong to the given hosts.

proxyids.description: Return only items that are monitored by the given proxies.

interfaceids.description: Return only items that use the given host interfaces.

graphids.description: Return only items that are used in the given graphs.

triggerids.description: Return only items that are used in the given triggers.

webitems.description: Include web items in the result.

inherited.description: If set to true return only items inherited from a template.

templated.description: If set to true return only items that belong to templates.

monitored.description: If set to true return only enabled items that belong to monitored hosts.

group.description: Return only items that belong to a group with the given name.

host.description: Return only items that belong to a host with the given name.

evaltype.description:
Tag evaluation method.

Possible values:
0 - (default) And/Or;
2 - Or.

with_triggers.description: If set to true return only items that are used in triggers.

selectHosts.description: Return a hosts property with an array of hosts that the item belongs to.

selectInterfaces.description: Return an interfaces property with an array of host interfaces used by the item.

selectTriggers.description:
Return a triggers property with the triggers that the item is used in.

Supports count.

selectGraphs.description:
Return a graphs property with the graphs that contain the item.

Supports count.

selectDiscoveryRule.description: Return a discoveryRule property with the LLD rule that created the item.

selectPreprocessing.description: Return a preprocessing property with item preprocessing options.

selectTags.description: Return the item tags in tags property.

selectValueMap.description: Return a valuemap property with item value map.

filter.description:
Return only those results that exactly match the given filter.

Accepts an object, where the keys are property names, and the values are either a single value or an array of values to match against.

Does not support properties of text data type.

Supports additional properties:
host - technical name of the host that the item belongs to.

limitSelects.description:
Limits the number of records returned by subselects.

Applies to the following subselects:
selectGraphs - results will be sorted by name;
selectTriggers - results will be sorted by description.

sortfield.description:
Sort the result by the given properties.

Possible values: itemid, name, key_, delay, history, trends, type, status.

countOutput.description: Return the number of records in the result instead of the actual data.

editable.description: If set to true, return only objects that the user has write permissions to. Default: false.

excludeSearch.description: Return results that do not match the criteria given in the search parameter.

limit.description: Limit the number of records returned.

output.description: Object properties to be returned. Default: extend.

preservekeys.description: Use IDs as keys in the resulting array.

search.description: Return results that match the given pattern (case-insensitive). Supports string and text properties.

searchByAny.description: If true, return results that match any of the criteria given in the filter or search parameter. Default: false.

searchWildcardsEnabled.description: If true, enables the use of '*' as a wildcard character. Default: false.

sortorder.description: Order of sorting. ASC or DESC.

startSearch.description: The search parameter will compare the beginning of fields. Ignored if searchWildcardsEnabled is set.
